entries.4d829432ba70fa09: This business category, which is not included in the reportable segments, carries out businesses in experience-type facility operation, funds, overseas operations and others. The condominium brand was unified under the name Brillia in 2003. Consolidated subsidiaries also handle condominium management and WEB promotion for condominium sales.

Consolidated subsidiaries also provide building management and cleaning, operate serviced offices and coworking spaces, and manage and operate commercial facilities.
